notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Bind to Life using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Bind to Life using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vastlands Scavenger.
When Vastlands Scavenger enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
